fit_reason: Whole pickup truck listed by a private seller.
findings: Yellowed, hazy headlight lenses on both front headlights
Dull, flat-looking silver paint on the hood and front bumper
Smudges and grime on the front bumper below the grille
Dirt and grime on the rear bumper and around the tailgate area
Faded black grille insert and lower front bumper trim
message: Hi, we saw your Tacoma listed on Marketplace. The headlights look pretty yellowed and hazy in the front shots, and the hood paint is looking a little flat. We do mobile pre-sale details including headlight restoration and a buff, and we come to you. Would you like a quote?
